description.value: PET images were realigned, normalized to MNI space, smoothed, and globally normalized.

spans.text: Pre-processing included rigid-body transformation (realignment) to correct for head movement. The PET images were then normalized to the MNI space by means of non-linear warping as implemented in SPM12, smoothed with a Gaussian filter of 12 mm full-width at half maximum (FWHM) to increase the signal-to-noise ratio and to facilitate group-level analyses (similar results were obtained using 8 mm FWHM). Individual global counts were finally normalized via proportional scaling to a mean value of 50 mg/100 mL/min.
